# decompiler_tool

[← Command index](README.md)

Open Ghidra with Python support, or run a PyGhidra script against a Ghidra project.

## Synopsis

```
decompiler_tool [options]
```

## Description

`LaunchProgram` (the default) starts the Ghidra GUI through PyGhidra (`python -m
pyghidra -g`), so Python scripts can be used inside it. `RunScript` runs a PyGhidra
script headless against an existing Ghidra project.

Both use the JoyBox Python virtual environment and the Ghidra installed by
`setup_tools` (its `lib` directory is passed as `GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR`).

A script can be run two ways. In preset mode, `--preset` and `--script` pick a
project and script defined in `Shared/joybox/config/decompiler.py`, with paths
relative to the preset's repository under `[UserData.Dirs] repositories_dir`, and the
script's default arguments. In manual mode, give `--project_dir`, `--project_name`,
`--program_name`, `--script_path` and `--script_name` yourself.

The script is called as `python <script> <project_dir> <project_name> <program_name>
[script_args]`. It runs with `-Djava.awt.headless=true` added to
`JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`, so it never needs a display.

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-a, --action <LaunchProgram\|RunScript>` | `LaunchProgram` opens the Ghidra GUI; `RunScript` runs a script headless. Default: `LaunchProgram`. Allowed: `LaunchProgram`, `RunScript`. |

### Project (manual mode)

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-n, --project_name <project_name>` | Name of the Ghidra project inside `--project_dir`. |
| `-l, --project_language <project_language>` | Ghidra language id of the program; not passed to the script. Default: `x86:LE:32:watcom`. |
| `-c, --project_cspec <project_cspec>` | Ghidra compiler spec of the program; not passed to the script. Default: `watcomcpp`. |
| `-r, --project_dir <project_dir>` | Directory holding the Ghidra project; it must exist. |
| `-g, --program_name <program_name>` | Program in the project to run the script on, e.g. `nocedit.exe`. |

### Preset mode

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--preset <preset>` | Preset name, e.g. `NocturneDecomp`; see `--list_presets`. |
| `--script <script>` | Script name within the preset, e.g. `export_all`; see `--list_scripts`. |

### Script (manual mode)

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--script_path <script_path>` | Directory holding the script; it must exist. |
| `--script_name <script_name>` | Script filename inside `--script_path`, e.g. `export_annotations.py`. |
| `--script_args <script_args>` | Extra argument passed to the script after the program name; in preset mode it replaces the preset's defaults. |

### Listing

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--list_presets` | List the presets with their descriptions and exit. |
| `--list_scripts` | List the scripts of `--preset`, or of every preset when omitted, and exit. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Open Ghidra with PyGhidra

```bash
decompiler_tool
```

### List the presets

```bash
decompiler_tool --list_presets
```

### List the scripts of one preset

```bash
decompiler_tool --list_scripts --preset NocturneDecomp
```

### Run a preset script with its default arguments

```bash
decompiler_tool -a RunScript --preset NocturneDecomp --script export_all
```

### Run a preset script with other arguments

```bash
decompiler_tool -a RunScript --preset NocturneDecomp --script export_nocedit --script_args ~/annotations/nocedit
```

### Run a script by hand against a project

```bash
decompiler_tool -a RunScript -r ~/Repositories/NocturneDecomp/projects -n NocturneEdit -g nocedit.exe --script_path ~/Repositories/NocturneDecomp/scripts/Python --script_name export_annotations.py
```

### Dry run without starting Python

```bash
decompiler_tool -a RunScript --preset NocturneDecomp --script export_all -p -v
```

## Notes

- `--script_args` replaces the preset's default arguments, and is passed to the script as one argument, not split on spaces.
- Ghidra must be installed with `setup_tools -k Ghidra`, or the command reports that the installation was not found.
- `--list_presets` and `--list_scripts` exit without running anything; `--list_scripts` without `--preset` lists the scripts of every preset.
